newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coms21, AAP form Internet betting pact.
newsitem.headline: Coms21, AAP form Internet betting pact.

text.p: Technology design group Coms21 Ltd said on Thursday it had signed an information agreement with Australian information services provider AAP to support Coms21's Internet gaming and wagering service.

AAP will provide racing and sports information to Coms21 unit, IWN Australasia Ltd, to be used on the group's Internet site for its agreement with the New Zealand TAB to develop and operate an Internet wagering service, Coms21 said.
It said the effect of this agreement is that people wil be able to look at racing form and sports information on their home computers and then place bets through the New Zealand TAB.
Coms21 said the agreement is for five years.
